# ubiops Provider

The UbiOps provider manages resources on the UbiOps platform for ML model serving and orchestration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.0"

  required_providers {
    ubiops = {
      source  = "registry.terraform.io/ubiops/ubiops"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

# Configure the UbiOps provider
provider "ubiops" {
  # api_token = "abc123"  # raw token — the provider prepends "Token " automatically
  # base_url  = "https://api.ubiops.com/v2.1"   # Or set UBIOPS_BASE_URL
}
```

## Environment Variables

In addition to the schema attributes below, the client honors:

- `UBIOPS_API_TOKEN` - equivalent to `api_token`.
- `UBIOPS_BASE_URL` - equivalent to `base_url`.
- `UBIOPS_TF_INSECURE_SKIP_VERIFY` - set to `1` to skip TLS certificate verification, e.g. for a self-hosted UbiOps instance behind an internal CA. Off by default; only set this if you understand the security implications.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_token` (String, Sensitive) API token for authentication. Can also be set via the `UBIOPS_API_TOKEN` environment variable.
- `base_url` (String) Base URL of the UbiOps API. Defaults to `https://api.ubiops.com/v2.1`. Can also be set via the `UBIOPS_BASE_URL` environment variable.
- `resolve` (String) Pin the `base_url` host to a specific IP instead of resolving it via DNS (equivalent to curl --resolve), e.g. `34.6.140.180`. Useful when the DNS record for a self-hosted UbiOps instance hasn't propagated yet; remove this setting once that DNS record resolves correctly on its own.
